answer: Minimum-inter-action spacing resists sybils: consecutive consequential actions by one identity must be separated by a minimum elapsed time, so no account can fire a burst. A canyon of fakes each throttled to one action per spacing window means aggregate throughput scales only with the number of REAL aged identities, not with how fast an attacker spams. The mesa of total influence rises with elapsed time across distinct relics of tenure; compressing a flood into an instant is structurally impossible.
